recovered_elements.text: Deepa Raju
Email:deeparajubellan@gmail.com
Phone:9047591319 Location: Bangalore
Professional profile

Fund Accounting professional with 10+ years of experience in Cash & Position Reconciliation, Trade Settlement, NAV Support, Corporate Actions, Fixed Income, Equities, Derivatives, SWIFT Messaging, Trade Lifecycle, pricing validation, and collaborating with brokers, custodians, and middle office teams. Seeking a challenging role where my skills and commitment to excellence will contribute to the growth of the Organization.
Professional Experience State Street (Apr 2019 - Dec 2025)
Performed cash and share position reconciliations between the accounting system and custodian records, investigating and resolving all outstanding breaks before NAV release.
Conducted security pricing validation by obtaining market prices from approved sources, including Bloomberg, Global Plus, client websites, emails, and other authorized pricing platforms.
Verified and processed corporate actions, including dividend and ensuring accurate portfolio valuation.
Coordinated with client operations, oversight, cash operations, corporate actions, pricing, and custody teams to resolve operational issues impacting NAV.
Managed client queries by performing detailed investigations and providing timely resolutions while maintaining service level agreements (SLAs).
Performed General Ledger (GL) to Sub-Ledger reconciliations to ensure completeness and accuracy of accounting records.

Released monthly NAV reports to clients through Document Type Definition (DTD) and CD reporting processes in accordance with client reporting schedules. • Performed NAV validation by reviewing tolerance exceptions, investigating
significant NAV movements, and documenting appropriate justifications before final approval.
Published daily NAVs to NASDAQ after completing all validation checks and obtaining required approvals.
Consistently met critical NAV deadlines by effectively prioritizing work, resolving complex reconciliation issues, and collaborating with cross-functional global teams.
JP Morgan Chase (Feb 2018 – Mar 2019)
Performed daily cash and position reconciliations between the accounting system and custodian records to ensure accurate portfolio reporting.
Supported the fund accounting team in the daily NAV calculation by investigating reconciliation breaks before NAV release.
Reviewed and validated equity, fixed income, FX, and derivative transactions to ensure accurate accounting.
• Monitored the complete trade lifecycle from trade capture through settlement and
accounting.
Assisted in processing corporate actions, including dividends, stock splits, mergers, and rights issues, ensuring accurate portfolio updates.
Validated security prices and FX rates using approved market data sources before NAV calculation.
Performed month-end accounting activities, including accrual validation and reconciliation of investment balances.
Conducted root cause analysis for aged reconciliation breaks and implemented corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
Prepared operational reports and participated in daily client calls.
State Street HCL Services (Mar 2014 – Apr 2017)
Performed cash and securities settlement reconciliation between Geneva, custodian

records, and broker statements to ensure accurate accounting. Investigated settlement exceptions arising from instruction mismatches, failed trades, corporate actions, pricing differences, and FX issues.
Coordinated with middle office, fund accounting, custody, and trading teams to resolve settlement breaks before NAV cut-off times.
Monitored DVP (Delivery Versus Payment) and RVP (Receive Versus Payment) settlements to ensure successful exchange of securities and cash.
Supported processing of FOP (Free of Payment) transfers for internal security movements and custody transfers.
Reviewed settlement reports daily and ensured all outstanding items were tracked, escalated, and resolved within SLA timelines.
Validated SWIFT settlement instructions and collaborated with counterparties to resolve settlement discrepancies.
Participated in daily operational and client calls to provide updates on settlement status, aged breaks, and high-priority exceptions.
Worked with IT team for Missing SSI setup and issue in missing trades or any technical issue. Interacted with custodians for trade unmatched issues.
Escalated unsettled trades to middle office & management as per escalation matrix and prepared daily reports for outstanding trades/breaks.
Perform Pre-Matching and Fails Management by adhering to the market and settlement deadlines of specific markets.
Technical Skills
Geneva • Bloomberg • Global Plus • SWIFT
Academic Qualifications
MBA - (Finance & HR) Anna University Chennai - 2013 B.COM – (Computer Application) Bharathiar University - 2011
